settings.renderer_description: Leave empty to use the bundled renderer or the development build.
settings.pause_lock: Pause while locked or session is inactive
settings.fullscreen_description: Niri compatibility mode: fullscreen flag plus the active full-size tile. Ambiguous matches keep playing.
settings.fullscreen_focused: Fullscreen pause only on the focused display
settings.optimize_description: Reduce decoding work with cached FPS/resolution-limited copies. Original files remain unchanged. Preparation takes time and disk space.
settings.ac_only: Prepare copies only on AC power
settings.slow_fps_description: Keep source frames and slow playback to the selected FPS instead of discarding frames. Example: 60 to 30 FPS plays at half speed. No effect with Source FPS or a cap above the source FPS. Requires a new playback copy.
